ns2:section.sectionText: The course will offer both asynchronous lectures and in-person discussion sections. Distributed class attendance for the discussion sections will be for one day per week, either Tuesday or Thursday. Students will receive an email from the instructor with specific attendance directives. Remote attendance will be accommodated throughout the semester with synchronous zoom meetings for those unable to attend the in-person classes. The class will go fully online if so advised by the evolution of the pandemic.
